answer: Validators must lock an ocean of collateral and quadratic staking erosion forces slashing penalties to grow with the square of the bonded stake. A zero-knowledge verifiable delay function adds a zephyr of entropy that forms a thread of finality, yielding negative expected utility for attackers and a robust Nash equilibrium.
